record.body:
verdict: NEEDS_WORK
findings:
  - task: oracle-contract
    kind: invariant-violation
    expected: Contract edits for R3/R4 land only under the authoritative `records` list (acceptance freeze fields + `oracle-amendment`); verify/shape checks read that key.
    observed: `contract/project-design.json` also appends a full parallel top-level `record_types` catalog (~600 lines) duplicating `records`, added so verify one-liners that read `d['record_types']` pass. Runtime validation uses `records` only; the alias is unused by skills/tests and can drift silently.
    severity: major
integration:
  interfaces: plan-phase oracle-author + freeze (`test_ids`/`oracle_hashes`/`verify_command`); execute-phase frozen-oracle brief + `project:oracle-amendment` requested→approved/rejected; verify-work mechanical oracle verify; `aff check` writes `failing_node_ids`; `close_batch` gates via `oracle_red.is_assertion_level_red` + green-revision hash match / approved `new_hashes`; contract `records` acceptance optional freeze fields and `oracle-amendment` (current-status, Reason/Change, status enum, refs).
  assumptions: Pytest tails expose AssertionError/`E assert` in the check-run body tail; legacy acceptances without parseable freeze fields skip oracle gates; finding escape still bypasses red-first and oracle gates; unit tests that inject `load_check_run` without acceptance hooks skip oracle store lookups by design.
  invariants: Oracle author ≠ executor (skills); frozen hashes are close authority (close refuses silent drift); assertion-level red required for freeze and oracle-backed done close; parent-only freeze/amendment writes (skills); claim-witnesses red-first ancestry retained under oracle gates.
  conflicts: Dual `records`/`record_types` catalogs in the design file (see finding); CLI close-batch covers happy path + refuse (hash drift, import-only red) but approved-amendment allow remains unit-only; classifier is pytest-tail shaped (unusual failure formats may false-negative).
record.subject: oracle-witnesses-review
